title: Summa MST Inclusion Checker
description: Paste a published Merkle-sum-tree root (hash + sum) and an inclusion proof for one leaf, verify membership AND local balance-sum-chain consistency, entirely offline. Independently recomputes both the hash chain and the sum chain and rejects any negative balance or over-bound value anywhere in the path, closing the Maxwell eprint 2022/043 'broken MST' hazard at the application layer. Verify-only: never a solvency or reserve-sufficiency claim.

id.description: Opaque hex leaf identifier -- never a real account/username

max_balance.description: Declared MAX_BALANCE domain bound, decimal-string BigInt (verification parameter, pre-filled with a sane default)

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_summa_mst_inclusion
mcp_tool_definition.description: Verifies a Merkle-sum-tree inclusion proof for one leaf against a published root: recomputes both the hash chain and the sum chain independently, and rejects negative or over-bound balances anywhere in the path (the Maxwell 2022/043 'broken MST' hazard). Verify-only -- never a solvency claim.
